items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: Johnny Sensei and George Foster was living together. On that morning, Johnny Sensei had his son.

ctx.x: You've been working, you say, at the Cotton Building, was that? Or something like that? They had a way in town. At a day job. Yeah.

So, what I did, while they go to the Wake, they get me there, Bob Sharper go. Bob Sharper turned the leadership over to Eddie Allen. And that made a hard feelings. That made a hard feeling. But when I go to St. Louis, Sidney didn't go to me, but... I go to St. Louis, when this guy, Captain, I want him to come to meet me at the train. At the train. At the train, the guy would say hello to me and all that, but he knew that I was the fella that he was looking for. You know, they had them big old-looking mind…
